$comment: Obligation rulebook. Pure data — the deadline engine (src/engine/deadlines.js) turns these into dated occurrences per profile. appliesTo predicates reference flags derived in src/engine/profile.js. Every entry cites its legal basis; 'confidence' is 'verified' only when checked against a primary source on the date in meta.json. 'overrides' records deadline extensions issued after the fact (e.g. a BIR RMC moving a filing season): {obligationId, rawDate (the date set by law) or period, newDate, basis}; the calendar shows the new date as 'Extended to <date> by <basis>'.

obligations.title: File & pay quarterly income tax
obligations.desc: Cumulative year-to-date income tax for individuals in business or practice, less prior quarters' payments and creditable withholding.
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 74(A), as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN)
obligations.notes: No Q4 return; the fourth quarter is reconciled on the annual return. The Q1 filing is also where the 8% election is made each year. Claiming 2307 credits for the quarter? The SAWT goes with the return via eSubmission (RR 2-2006); scanned 2307s may be lodged through eAFS quarterly groups.

obligations.title: File annual income tax return
obligations.desc: Simplified annual return for purely self-employed individuals on the 8% rate or graduated rates with OSD, reconciling all quarterly filings and 2307 credits.
obligations.notes: Income tax due above ₱2,000 may be paid in two equal installments: at filing, and on or before October 15 (NIRC Sec 56(A)(2), as amended by TRAIN). Attachments (SAWT confirmation, 2307s) go to eAFS within 15 days of the statutory deadline or the actual e-filing date, whichever comes later; see the attachments deadline on this calendar. No FS attach on the 8% option or OSD.

obligations.title: File annual income tax return
obligations.desc: Full annual return for mixed-income earners and individuals claiming itemized deductions, reconciling all quarterly filings and credits.
obligations.notes: Attach Form 2316 from your employer (mixed income) and SAWT with 2307s where credits are claimed (the SAWT itself is filed via eSubmission with the return). Itemized-deduction filers attach financial statements: audited with SMR when gross sales exceed ₱3M, not necessarily audited (or the AIF) at or below; only 8%/OSD filers attach no FS at all (NIRC Sec 232; RR 16-2008). Attachments go to eAFS within 15 days of the statutory deadline or actual e-filing, whichever comes later, a separately dated item on this calendar.

obligations.title: Submit SAWT with each income tax return
obligations.desc: Summary Alphalist of Withholding Taxes: the alphalist of every 2307 certificate claimed as a credit, filed via eSubmission together with the quarterly 1701Q and the annual return.
obligations.notes: Due whenever a return claims 2307 credits: a .dat file built with the BIR data entry module and emailed to esubmission@bir.gov.ph (or attached in eFPS), due when the return itself is due. The April 15 occurrence rides the annual 1701/1701A. Keep the email validation report: it is the proof uploaded to eAFS with the scanned 2307s. No SAWT and the claimed credits are exposed to disallowance. Also rides the 2550Q/2551Q on the rarer occasions withholding is credited on those returns. Nothing claimed for a period, nothing due.

obligations.title: File annual income tax return (compensation)
obligations.desc: Employees outside substituted filing (e.g. two or more employers during the year) file their own annual return on compensation income.

obligations.title: Collect BIR Form 2316 from your employer
obligations.desc: Your employer's certificate of compensation paid and tax withheld; with one employer and correct withholding it doubles as your filed return.
legalBasis: RR 2-98 Sec 2.83.1, as amended by RR 11-2018
obligations.notes: Employers must issue the certificate on or before January 31 of the following year, or on the day of last payment for terminated employment.

obligations.title: File & pay quarterly corporate income tax
obligations.desc: Cumulative corporate income tax for the taxable year to date, less prior quarterly payments and creditable withholding.
obligations.notes: Due within 60 days following the close of each of the first three quarters of the taxable year, calendar or fiscal. SAWT via eSubmission when 2307 credits are claimed; scanned 2307s may go through eAFS quarterly groups (RMC 82-2020).

obligations.title: File annual corporate income tax return
obligations.desc: Year-end corporate return: regular corporate income tax compared against the minimum corporate income tax where applicable.
obligations.notes: Due the 15th day of the fourth month following the close of the taxable year (April 15 for calendar-year corporations). Variants: 1702-EX (exempt), 1702-MX (mixed/special-rate regimes; RBEs attach the CETI). Attachments include FS + SMR (audited only when gross sales exceed ₱3M per NIRC Sec 232, though FS attach even on OSD per RR 16-2008), SAWT/2307s, and Form 1709 for covered related-party taxpayers; these go to eAFS within 15 days of the deadline or actual e-filing, whichever comes later (fiscal-year naming per RMC 82-2020); a separately dated item on this calendar. E-filing is mandatory for all corporations (RMC 20-2026).

obligations.title: Submit SAWT with the quarterly income tax return
obligations.desc: Summary Alphalist of Withholding Taxes: the alphalist of every 2307 certificate claimed as a credit on the 1702Q, filed via eSubmission with the return.
obligations.notes: Due with each 1702Q (within 60 days of the close of each of the first three quarters, following the corporation's taxable year) whenever 2307 credits are claimed for the quarter; nothing claimed, nothing due. A .dat file via eSubmission (esubmission@bir.gov.ph) or eFPS; scanned 2307s may go through eAFS quarterly groups (RMC 82-2020).

obligations.title: Submit SAWT with the annual income tax return
obligations.desc: Summary Alphalist of Withholding Taxes: the alphalist of every 2307 certificate claimed as a credit on the annual 1702, filed via eSubmission with the return.
obligations.notes: Due with the annual return, the 15th day of the fourth month after year-end. Keep the email validation report; it goes to eAFS (Other Attachments group) with the scanned 2307s within the 15-day attachment window. No SAWT and the claimed credits are exposed to disallowance.

obligations.title: Submit annual ITR attachments via eAFS
obligations.desc: Scanned attachments to the annual return: SAWT eSubmission confirmation, 2307s and 2304s, 2316 (mixed income / 1700 filers), for itemized-deduction filers the FS (audited above ₱3M gross sales, unaudited below), plus tax debit memos and credit proofs where applicable, uploaded to eAFS in the prescribed PDF file groups.
legalBasis: RMC 44-2021 (15 days from the statutory deadline or actual e-filing, whichever is later)
RMC 20-2026 (CY2025 guidelines; eAFS as the default channel)
obligations.notes: April 30 is the date for returns filed by April 15; file the return late and the 15-day window runs from the actual e-filing date instead. Only 'if applicable': nothing to upload means nothing due. Skipping it costs ₱1,000 per document (₱500 for micro/small taxpayers) and puts claimed 2307 credits at risk; season RMCs occasionally move the date (May 15, 2026 for CY2025 per RMC 30-2026/39-2026).

obligations.title: Pay the 2nd installment of annual income tax (only if you paid half with your return)
obligations.desc: If the income tax due on your annual return (1700, 1701 or 1701A) was over ₱2,000, you may pay half when you file and the other half by October 15. Skip this if you paid the full amount with your return.
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 56(A)(2), as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN)
obligations.notes: Individuals only (corporations pay in full). The choice is made on the annual return by entering the amount deferred to the second installment; the balance is due on or before October 15 of the year the return is filed. Paying it late brings the surcharge and interest on the unpaid half.

obligations.title: Submit annual ITR attachments via eAFS
obligations.desc: Corporate annual-return attachments: the FS with SMR (audited with auditor's report when gross sales exceed ₱3M), SAWT confirmation with 2307s and 2304s, Form 1709, CETI, tax debit memos and credit proofs where applicable, uploaded to eAFS in the prescribed PDF file groups.
legalBasis: RMC 44-2021 (15 days from the statutory deadline or actual e-filing, whichever is later)
obligations.notes: 15 days after the annual return's due date (April 30 for calendar-year corporations filing by April 15); a late-filed return runs the window from actual e-filing instead. The eAFS Transaction Reference Number doubles as the BIR-received proof the SEC accepts with the AFS.

obligations.title: File & pay quarterly percentage tax
obligations.desc: 3% of gross quarterly sales or receipts for non-VAT taxpayers under the VAT threshold who have not elected the 8% income tax option.
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 116 & 128(A)(1), as amended by RA 11534 (CREATE)
obligations.notes: Within 25 days after the close of each taxable quarter. Electing the 8% option removes this filing entirely for the year.

obligations.title: File & pay quarterly VAT
obligations.desc: Output VAT on sales less creditable input VAT for the taxable quarter.
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 114(A), as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN) & RA 11976 (EOPT)
obligations.notes: Quarterly filing only; the monthly 2550M has not been required since January 2023, though RMC 52-2023 still allows optional monthly filing for the first two months of a quarter. Since April 27, 2024 the VAT base for services is gross SALES (billed/accrual), with an output-VAT credit for receivables that stay uncollected past the agreed period (Sec 110(D), RMC 65-2024).

obligations.title: Submit the Summary List of Sales & Purchases (SLSP)
obligations.desc: Quarterly electronic list of sales, purchases, and importations, required of all VAT-registered taxpayers, filed via eSubmission alongside the 2550Q.
legalBasis: RR 16-2005 Sec 4.114-3, as amended by RR 1-2012 (all VAT taxpayers, no threshold)
obligations.notes: Confirmed still required as of Aug 2026; no e-invoicing issuance has retired it (the first RR 11-2025 group only becomes mandatory Dec 31, 2026). RELIEF .dat files via eSubmission, due the 25th after the quarter (30th for eFPS/LTS filers); submit zero lists for quiet quarters. Taxpayers already transmitting to the EIS (RR 8-2022) are relieved of the sales list only. ₱1,000 per unfiled list, capped ₱25,000/year.

obligations.title: Be ready for mandatory e-invoicing
obligations.desc: Taxpayers in e-commerce (except micro), large taxpayers, and users of computerized accounting systems must issue structured electronic invoices by the compliance deadline.
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 237-A, as amended by CREATE MORE (RA 12066)
RR 26-2025 (amends RR 11-2025; keeps the Dec 31, 2026 deadline)
obligations.notes: Coverage shown here is approximate (CAS/POS users; also e-commerce sellers above micro size and large taxpayers). The Dec 31, 2026 date for the first covered group was reconfirmed in October 2026 (RR 26-2025 keeps it), but confirm whether this taxpayer is covered; until then SLSP/eSubmission duties continue unchanged.

obligations.title: Remit withholding tax on compensation
obligations.desc: Income tax withheld from employees' pay for the month.
legalBasis: RR 2-98 Sec 2.81, as amended by RR 11-2018
obligations.notes: Due the 10th day of the month following the month withheld, except December's, due January 15. eFPS filers follow slightly later staggered dates (RR 26-2002); the dates shown are the earlier non-eFPS deadlines.

obligations.title: File annual information return (compensation)
obligations.desc: Year-end summary of all compensation paid and tax withheld, with the employee alphalist. Must reconcile with the twelve 1601-C filings.
obligations.notes: Alphalist submitted electronically via the BIR Alphalist Data Entry & Validation Module (v7.4 per RMC 15-2025, patched Nov 2025 and Jan 2026; re-validate after each patch) through eSubmission. The alphalist is an integral part of the return: one that fails validation is deemed not received and the return treated as not validly filed.

obligations.title: Issue Form 2316 to every employee
obligations.desc: Certificate of compensation paid and tax withheld for each employee for the prior year, signed by both employer and employee.
legalBasis: RR 2-98 Sec 2.83.1, as amended by RR 11-2018

obligations.title: Submit employees' 2316 copies to the BIR
obligations.desc: Scanned copies of substituted-filing employees' signed 2316s, with the notarized sworn declaration (Annex C, RR 2-2015) and the certified list of employees qualified for substituted filing (Annex F, RR 11-2018).
legalBasis: RR 2-2015 as amended by RR 16-2021 (scanned copies/eAFS/USB)
RMC 29-2024 (only the two annexes may be required; both signatures mandatory)
obligations.notes: Not later than February 28 following the close of the calendar year, for substituted-filing employees. Scans must bear BOTH employer and employee signatures (e-signatures valid per RMC 29-2021; unsigned employee copies no longer accepted per RMC 29-2024). Accepted modes: eAFS scanned PDFs, DVD-R, or USB, one mode per period; files named Surname_TIN_TaxablePeriod, alphabetical.

obligations.title: Remit expanded withholding tax
obligations.desc: Creditable tax withheld from suppliers (rent, professional fees, contractors) for the first two months of each quarter.
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 58(A), as amended by RA 10963
obligations.notes: Only months 1 and 2 of each calendar quarter; the third month is picked up by the quarterly 1601-EQ. eFPS filers have staggered dates (RR 26-2002); shown are non-eFPS deadlines.

obligations.title: File quarterly expanded withholding tax return
obligations.desc: Quarterly consolidation of all expanded withholding, crediting the two monthly 0619-E remittances, with the Quarterly Alphalist of Payees (QAP).
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 58(A), as amended by RA 10963
obligations.notes: Due the last day of the month following the close of the calendar quarter. The QAP is an integral part of the return, due the same date, tracked as its own item on this calendar.

obligations.title: Submit the Quarterly Alphalist of Payees (QAP)
obligations.desc: Electronic alphalist of every payee withheld from during the quarter, with ATCs and amounts, an integral part of the 1601-EQ / 1601-FQ, prepared with the BIR Alphalist Data Entry & Validation Module and filed via eSubmission.
legalBasis: RR 1-2014 & RMC 5-2014 (alphalist integral to the return)
RMC 15-2025 (Alphalist Data Entry & Validation Module v7.4)
obligations.notes: Due with the quarterly withholding return: the last day of the month after each calendar quarter, alongside the 1601-EQ (expanded) and/or 1601-FQ (final). A QAP that fails validation or doesn't conform to the format is deemed NOT received and the return treated as not validly filed, putting the related expense deductions at risk. Module v7.4 was patched Nov 2025 and Jan 2026; re-validate .dat files after each patch.

obligations.title: File annual information return (expanded withholding)
obligations.desc: Year-end summary of creditable (expanded) taxes withheld with the payee alphalist. Must reconcile with the four 1601-EQ filings.

obligations.title: Issue 2307 certificates to payees
obligations.desc: Certificate of creditable tax withheld for each supplier you withheld from during the quarter.
legalBasis: RR 2-98 Sec 2.58(B), as amended by RR 11-2018
obligations.notes: Within 20 days from the close of the quarter, or upon the payee's request together with the income payment.

obligations.title: Remit final withholding tax
obligations.desc: Final taxes withheld (e.g. on dividends or certain interest) for the first two months of each quarter.
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 58(A), as amended by RA 10963
obligations.notes: Only months 1 and 2 of each quarter; the third month is picked up by the quarterly 1601-FQ.

obligations.title: File quarterly final withholding tax return
obligations.desc: Quarterly consolidation of final withholding, crediting monthly 0619-F remittances, with the Quarterly Alphalist of Payees (QAP).
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 58(A), as amended by RA 10963
obligations.notes: Due the last day of the month following the close of the calendar quarter. Like the 1601-EQ, it carries the Quarterly Alphalist of Payees (QAP) via eSubmission, tracked as its own item on this calendar.

obligations.title: File annual information return (final withholding)
obligations.desc: Year-end summary of final taxes withheld, with alphalist.

obligations.title: Issue 2306 certificates to payees
obligations.desc: Certificate of final tax withheld for each payee subjected to final withholding during the year.
legalBasis: RR 2-98 Sec 2.58(B), as amended by RR 11-2018
obligations.notes: On or before January 31 of the year following the year the income payment was made, or upon the payee's request together with the payment. The creditable-withholding counterpart, the 2307, is issued quarterly instead.

obligations.title: Remit SSS contributions (employer)
obligations.desc: Employer and employee shares of SSS contributions for the prior month, including the employees' compensation (EC) premium.
legalBasis: SSS Circular 2019-012 (unified payment deadlines under the PRN regime)
obligations.notes: Employers pay on or before the last day of the month following the applicable month (re-verified Aug 26, 2026). Generate the PRN in the My.SSS portal before paying.

obligations.title: Remit PhilHealth premiums (employer)
obligations.desc: Employer and employee shares of PhilHealth premiums for the prior month.
legalBasis: PhilHealth Circular No. 0001, s. 2014 (staggered windows by PEN)
obligations.notes: Staggered by PhilHealth Employer Number: PEN ending 0–4 remit on the 11th–15th, PEN 5–9 on the 16th–20th of the following month (re-verified Aug 26, 2026). The 15th is shown as the safe-side date; check your exact window in EPRS.

obligations.title: Remit Pag-IBIG contributions (employer)
obligations.desc: Employer and employee shares of Pag-IBIG (HDMF) savings for the prior month.
legalBasis: HDMF Circular 275 (remittance staggered by first letter of the employer's registered name)
obligations.notes: Staggered by the first letter of the employer's REGISTERED name, in the month after the period: A–D the 10th–14th, E–L 15th–19th, M–Q 20th–24th, R–Z and numerals 25th–month-end. The 10th is shown as the safe-side date covering every window; check your own letter's window.

obligations.title: Pay SSS contributions (self-employed)
obligations.desc: Self-employed members pay their own SSS contribution based on their declared monthly earnings.
obligations.notes: Self-employed and voluntary members pay the full 15% themselves, monthly (last day of the following month, shown here) or quarterly (last day of the month following the quarter). OFW members get longer windows (Jan–Sep payable to Dec 31; Oct–Dec to Jan 31).

obligations.title: Pay PhilHealth premiums (self-employed)
obligations.desc: Direct contributors paying their own premium on declared monthly income.
obligations.notes: Quarterly, semi-annual, and annual payment options are also available.

obligations.title: Pay Pag-IBIG regular savings (self-employed)
obligations.desc: Self-employed members remit their own regular monthly Pag-IBIG savings.
obligations.notes: This is the regular monthly Pag-IBIG savings, not MP2 (Pag-IBIG's separate voluntary savings program). The name of the payment channel is not yet confirmed: check with Pag-IBIG.

obligations.title: Pay 13th month pay
obligations.desc: All rank-and-file employees who worked at least one month in the year must receive 13th month pay.
obligations.notes: Due on or before December 24; this deadline does NOT move later for weekends; pay earlier instead.

obligations.title: Report 13th-month compliance to DOLE
obligations.desc: Employers report 13th-month payment compliance through the DOLE establishment report system.
legalBasis: DOLE Labor Advisory No. 16-2025 (report via reports.dole.gov.ph by Jan 15, 2026, reiterated annually)
obligations.notes: January 15 of the following year has held across recent annual advisories; the report goes through the DOLE Establishment Report System (reports.dole.gov.ph). Watch each December's advisory for the odd change.

obligations.title: Renew business / mayor's permit
obligations.desc: Annual renewal of the LGU business permit and payment of local business tax for the year.
obligations.notes: Local business taxes accrue January 1 and are payable within the first 20 days of January. Many LGUs allow quarterly installments (within the first 20 days of each quarter). Barangay clearance is secured first.

obligations.title: Pay community tax (cedula)
obligations.desc: Yearly community tax for individuals who work for an employer, run a business or practice a profession, and for corporations.
legalBasis: Local Government Code (RA 7160) Sec 157 (individuals regularly employed on a wage or salary)
obligations.notes: Accrues January 1; payable without interest until the last day of February. Employees are included because LGC Sec 157 covers individuals regularly employed on a wage or salary for at least 30 consecutive working days in the year (the Code text was not re-checked for this release, so this is flagged for review).

obligations.title: Renew Professional Tax Receipt (PTR)
obligations.desc: Annual professional tax for PRC-licensed professionals practicing their profession.
obligations.notes: Payable on or before January 31 to the province/city where the professional practices.

obligations.title: Submit bound loose-leaf books
obligations.desc: Permanently bound copies of last year's loose-leaf books of accounts, with a sworn statement.
legalBasis: RMC 4-2026 (one-off extension of the Jan 2026 deadline to Jan 31)
obligations.notes: Within 15 days after the end of the taxable year (January 15 for calendar-year taxpayers; the Jan 2026 round was extended one-off to Jan 31 for ORUS outages). Registration runs through ORUS; the QR 'stamp' goes on the first page of the bound volume; the bound books themselves go to your RDO with the sworn statement.

obligations.title: Register computerized books of accounts
obligations.desc: Annual registration/submission of computerized books and other accounting records in electronic format.
obligations.notes: Within 30 days from the close of the taxable year (January 30 for calendar-year taxpayers).

obligations.title: Submit annual inventory list
obligations.desc: Detailed list of ending inventory (goods, materials, supplies) as of year-end.
obligations.notes: Within 30 days following the close of the taxable year (January 30 for calendar-year taxpayers).

obligations.title: File audited financial statements with the SEC
obligations.desc: Annual audited FS filed through the SEC's eFAST system, with one uniform deadline for calendar-year corporations, set by the year's SEC memorandum circular.
legalBasis: SEC MC 9-2026 (Feb 11, 2026: single uniform date via eFAST; FY2025's May 29 was revised to June 15, 2026 after the BIR's AITR extension)
obligations.notes: The SEC sets the exact date each year by memorandum circular; the old last-digit staggering is gone, but the date can move mid-year (FY2025: May 29 → June 15, 2026). Later years shown at May 29 until each year's MC issues. Attach the BIR eAFS Transaction Reference Number in lieu of a BIR-stamped AFS. PSE-listed/public companies follow the 105-day SEC Form 17-A rule instead. Corporations with total assets or total liabilities under ₱600,000 file FS certified under oath by the treasurer/CFO instead of audited (RCC Sec 177).

obligations.title: File audited financial statements with the SEC
obligations.desc: Fiscal-year corporations file audited FS via eFAST within 120 calendar days of fiscal year-end.
obligations.notes: Within 120 calendar days from the end of a fiscal year other than December 31 (per the annual SEC MC, most recently MC 9-2026). Corporations with total assets or total liabilities under ₱600,000 file FS certified under oath by the treasurer/CFO instead of audited (RCC Sec 177).

obligations.title: File the General Information Sheet (GIS)
obligations.desc: Within 30 calendar days from the annual stockholders' (or members') meeting, via eFAST.
legalBasis: SEC MC 9-2026 (30 calendar days from the actual annual meeting, via eFAST)
obligations.notes: The due date depends on your annual meeting date (often fixed in the by-laws). Diary it 30 days after the meeting; file through eFAST.

obligations.title: Elect the 8% option for the new year
obligations.desc: The 8% income tax election is made annually, on the year's first quarterly filing (1701Q due May 15, or 2551Q due Apr 25 if that comes first) or via Form 1905. Miss it and you default to graduated rates for the whole year.
obligations.notes: The election is irrevocable for the taxable year once made.

obligations.title: Issue BIR-registered invoices for every sale
obligations.desc: Since the EOPT Act, the invoice is the primary document for both goods and services; official receipts are supplementary only.
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 237, as amended by RA 11976 (EOPT)
obligations.notes: Mandatory issuance applies to sales of ₱500 or more (per transaction, adjustable every 3 years); issue one anyway when the buyer asks.

obligations.title: Keep books of accounts up to date
obligations.desc: Record income and expenses as they happen; preserve books and records for the statutory retention period.
legalBasis: NIRC Secs 232-235, as amended by RA 11976 (EOPT)
obligations.notes: EOPT cut the retention period to five (5) years. Books audited by an independent CPA are required when gross annual sales exceed ₱3,000,000 (a threshold set by TRAIN in Sec 232).

obligations.title: Annual registration fee: no longer due
obligations.desc: The ₱500 annual BIR registration fee (old Form 0605, due January 31) was abolished by the EOPT Act. Don't pay it, and keep your existing Certificate of Registration, which stays valid.
obligations.notes: Effective January 22, 2024.

obligations.title: One-time penalty abatement for micro taxpayers: avail by Dec 31, 2026
obligations.desc: Micro taxpayers (gross sales below ₱3M) can wipe out delinquencies, assessments, and open stop-filer cases as of Dec 31, 2025 (where the basic tax and/or penalties are ₱80,000 or less per taxable year) for a one-time ₱5,000 abatement fee.
legalBasis: RR 4-2026 (issued June 18, 2026; effective July 7, 2026, per firm alerts)
obligations.notes: Time-boxed: availment runs until December 31, 2026 (extendable by the DOF Secretary); this item is hidden from January 1, 2027. If you have old open 2550Q/2551Q cases or small assessments, ask your CPA whether this clears them before the window closes. The issuance and effectivity dates come from firm alerts (Grant Thornton, KPMG), not from the BIR text itself, and whether the ₱5,000 fee is per taxable year is reported inconsistently.

obligations.title: Renew your DTI business name every five years
obligations.desc: Sole proprietors' business-name registration is valid for five years from registration.
obligations.notes: Renewal window: from 180 days BEFORE expiry, then 90 days after expiry penalty-free, then 90 more days (days 91–180) with a 50% surcharge on the registration fee. Miss day 180 and the registration is cancelled and the name becomes available to others. Diary your own five-year date.

obligations.title: Keep CRM/POS reporting current
obligations.desc: BIR-registered cash register and POS machines carry their own registration and reporting duties (machine registration, sales reporting where required).
obligations.notes: Requirements vary with machine type and accreditation; confirm your unit's reporting duties with your RDO.

obligations.title: Keep your BIR registration current
obligations.desc: File Form 1905 when anything registered changes: address/RDO, trade name, tax types, books, or closure.
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 236, as amended by RA 11976 (EOPT)
obligations.notes: Under EOPT, transfers and updates can be filed at any RDO, with no transfer-first requirement (RA 11976; RMC 91-2024).

obligations.title: Fringe benefits tax: only if you grant managerial perks
obligations.desc: Benefits given to managerial or supervisory employees (car plans, housing, certain allowances) attract a 35% final fringe benefits tax on the grossed-up value, filed quarterly on Form 1603Q by the last day of the month after each quarter.
legalBasis: NIRC Sec 33, as amended by RA 10963
obligations.notes: Rank-and-file benefits are taxed through compensation withholding instead. If you grant such benefits, add the 1603Q dates to your calendar with your CPA.

obligations.title: Substituted filing usually covers you
obligations.desc: With one employer for the whole year and tax fully withheld, your employer's 1604-C filing plus your signed 2316 stand in for an annual return; nothing for you to file.
obligations.notes: You fall out of substituted filing if you had two or more employers during the year, your withholding was short, or you have other income to report.
